Every night, Yeo-Un takes the last train home—same route, same time, same routine. But one thing keeps catching his eye: a girl with a guitar and a presence that lingers in his mind. When the final note plays, will their story end in harmony… or heartbreak?

description:
Life sure is ruff, especially when you’re Gyeon Hui-Seong. Abandoned by his pack of fellow dog shifters, he is forced to become a drug runner for a gambling ring. For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yun Chi-Young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form…a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Hui-Seong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. title: The Sacred Serpent's Seduction

unknown.title: La seducción de la serpiente sagrada

description:
How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Tae-Sun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Tae-Sun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Tae-Sun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Tae-Sun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.*

(Source: WEBTOON)

title: Legroom
description:
*"My name is Song Gi-Tae. I’m 20 years old. That’s all I remember."*

Gi-Tae wakes up in a windowless room, with no memory of how he got there—only the steady rhythm of three meals a day delivered by the ever-gentle Cha Ji-Hun to hint at the passage of time. No matter how cold or cutting Gi-Tae becomes, Ji-Hun only responds with warm smiles and tender concern. But trust is a luxury Gi-Tae can’t afford. Not when the man bringing him food…is the same one who cut off his foot.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Pure Intentions
description:
For seven years, Seo Hyeon-Jin, a Korean literature major, has nursed a secret crush on his upperclassman Soon Jeong-Wook. Unfortunately, Jeong-Wook only sees him as a cherished junior, leaving Hyeon-Jin’s love life at a standstill. Everything changes when Heo Chan-Yeong, who perfectly matches Jeong-Wook’s type, transfers in. To make matters worse, Chan-Yeong boldly confesses his feelings for Jeong-Wook to Hyeon-Jin, explaining that he wants to sleep with him. As if that weren’t enough, Chan-Yeong even asks Hyeon-Jin to help him win Jeong-Wook’s heart. Determined to protect the man he loves, Hyeon-Jin finds himself caught in a battle of wits against Chan-Yeong, who only wants Jeong-Wook out of curiosity.

But when Hyeon-Jin realizes Chan-Yeong’s “interest” might not be so fixed after all, he starts to wonder…could the rival he’s trying to fend off become something else entirely?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Determined to avoid an antagonist's fate, Yeryeon works to nudge the story toward a different ending. But as her actions threaten to upend the lives of other characters, Yeryeon has to figure out how to get her satisfying story while also protecting the people she cares for. Will Yeryeon flip the script and change the drama for the better? Or will she be stuck playing the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas)

description:
The Devon family sits on a mountain of debt and they are on the brink of bankruptcy. This is no fault of hers of course, but Courtney Devon has always been the one painted as the villain in her family. However, the family is in dire straits and they have to do something, anything, to raise some money and get out of this situation. But then one day, news arrives from the Imperial Palace that His Royal Highness the crown prince has decided to make Courtney the crown princess. Seemingly a typical prince on the outside, His Royal Highness is actually quite a troublemaker with a dark side. Will this arrangement end up solving Courtney Devon’s problems or just complicating things further? Will a love against all odds bloom or will someone end up in the doghouse...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
In a cynical world where love has lost its luster, 37-year-old Ha-Yeong Kim is merely a shell of her former self. Empowered by her knowledge of what’s to come, Seon embarks on a mission to reshape her friends’ destinies. Bouncing between past and present, orchestrating grand changes, Seon begins to discover that altering others’ lives might be the key to rediscovering love, purpose, and the courage to dream again.

description:
One day, completely against his will, Kim Namju finds himself hexed by a sparkly fairy named Seobi—and just like that, he becomes the unwilling mascot of a team of magical girls. Their mission? To defeat the Demons of Desire, monsters born from the collective lust of humanity, who are now plotting to take over Earth. So far, so weird—but then comes the kicker. To truly purify these lust-fueled demons, Namju has to help the magical girls and monsters fulfill their wildest desires. Yes, all of them. Cue awkward moans, questionable missions, and Namju screaming,

*“This is NOT what I signed up for!”*

Now stuck between sparkles and sin, Namju must somehow save the world, preserve his sanity, and—if possible—not die of embarrassment. Saving Earth has never been this extra.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Scent Spark
description:
When defective omega and skilled mercenary Erad Nox is hired to find a runaway alpha mage and bring him back to the Tower of Mages, he thinks it'll be the easiest job he's ever done in his life. Little did he expect that upon meeting Lucian, the mage in question, he'd suddenly enter his heat cycle - something that hasn't happened in the past 11 years. Intrigued by this strange phenomenon, Lucian asks him to stay and become his research subject. As they spend time together, Nox finds himself drawn to Lucian's compassion and bashful kindness, while Lucian begins to fall in love with Nox's fearless strength and integrity.

(Source: Lezhin US)

unknown.title: 不変のユウォン〜俺らは再び出会ってしまった〜

description:
As a new transfer in his second year of high school, Gu Do-Hun faces relentless bullying for no clear reason—but his eyes are set on only one person: his quiet classmate, Jeong Yu-Won. Yu-Won tries to keep his distance, but Do-Hun’s strange, unreadable pull draws him in until a sudden, devastating incident rips them apart. Years later, they reunite as team leader and subordinate. Yu-Won tries to keep things professional, but the past refuses to stay buried...and neither does Do-Hun’s gaze. Something about him feels familiar yet entirely different. title: Dragon Heat
description:
Born from the legendary love between humans and dragons, the hybrid race known as Drik looks human but carries the strength, regeneration, and instinct of dragons, including a powerful heat cycle that returns again and again. Among them, Sieric Lorence stands apart, his bloodline so rich with dragon power that he has become an unrivaled knight. Sent by royal command to rescue researchers trapped in ancient ruins, Sieric crosses paths with Jahid, a petty thief trying to steal his sword, a blade forged from dragon bones. As Sieric prepares to punish him, fate strikes cruelly. His heat arrives unexpectedly, and without suppressants, he is left dangerously vulnerable. Noticing his condition, Jahid makes a bold offer. As a fellow Drik, he can help Sieric endure the heat, but only in exchange for his freedom.

In the heart of forgotten ruins, surrounded by danger and desire, a risky bargain is struck that could change both of their fates forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
At a college welcome party, Kang Ju-Yeong overhears a juicy rumor about Choi Hyun, a popular student from the Physical Education department—apparently, he accepts professions of love from almost anyone, even strangers. As the drinks flow, the conversation escalates into a daring bet: whoever confesses their love to Choi Hyun wins 100 dollars. Uncomfortable with the vibe, Ju-Yeong leaves the party, only to run into Choi Hyun as he's breaking up with someone. Seizing the moment, Ju-Yeong blurts out:

*"Go out with me too!"*

But unlike the others, Ju-Yeong’s profession isn’t just a spur-of-the-moment gamble—he’s been secretly in love with Choi Hyun since high school. With Hyun caught off guard and no way to take it back, the two start dating that very night. Will Ju-Yeong’s long-time crush turn into a lasting relationship, or is this love destined to be just another fleeting romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Marriage Blues
description:
On her wedding day, Hana Gu realizes her relationship lacks love and flees the ceremony. During her escapade, she runs into her ex-boyfriend, Gawi Nam who helps her by using his mysterious ability to time travel into the past. Determined to erase her unwanted marriage, she uses this ability to try and change her fate, but the future proves less malleable than expected. Amid repeated failures, she finds solace in Gawi, who is also trapped in the past, facing similar struggles. As they fight fate together, old feelings from their first love resurface, making Hana question -- does she truly want to change her fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
Young Ruan, the little lord of House Marcellion, has never had an easy childhood. With his older brother constantly feigning illness, the burden of the harsh heir’s training falls squarely on his small shoulders. One day, unable to take it any longer, Ruan dashes out of the mansion and loses himself in the forest. There, he stumbles upon a boy his own age. They don’t exchange names, and yet none of that seems to matter. With him, even nibbling on grass becomes an adventure. Ruan finds himself laughing, playing, and perhaps for the very first time, feeling free. Day by day, his thoughts drift further from the rigid lessons of succession and closer to the warmth of that kindhearted boy. But gossip spreads quickly, and soon even the stern Count Marcellion hears whispers of his son’s wandering heart… 

Could a simple forest friendship change the path of an heir? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.*

tags_v2.name: Tsundere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are initially cold, hostile, or prickly toward others (especially love interests), but gradually or occasionally reveal a softer, warmer, or caring side beneath their abrasive exterior. The term is a combination of "tsun" (ツンツン, tsuntsun, aloof or prickly) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.name: Yandere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are deeply, obsessively in love, often to the point of violence, possessiveness, or psychosis. They may appear sweet, shy, or affectionate at first, but their devotion can lead them to extreme actions—including harming rivals, kidnapping, or even killing to protect or keep their love interest. The term is a combination of "yan" (ヤン, from yanderu, sick or mentally ill) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

Abandoned by his father and orphaned, he endures harsh conditions, resorting to begging and eventually gambling for survival. With his life constantly in jeopardy, survival becomes Soun's sole focus, even if it means becoming the Demonic Sect's Leader's concubine for a chance at a peaceful end.

description:
Nick Stockton, ex-mercenary and now head of a top security firm, has never once lost control—until he crosses paths with Owen Rose, the stunning CEO of Rose Biotech. But Owen harbors a dark belief—that he’s a “monster Omega,” ever since a childhood incident where he injured his Alpha cousin. He’s spent his life in strict control… until Nick’s bold, relentless (and a bit reckless) pursuit shatters his defenses. As their bond deepens, Nick begins investigating the attack—and uncovers a chilling truth. This wasn’t just a strike against Rose Biotech. Someone is after Owen himself. And Nick will stop at nothing to protect what’s his.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Woo-Kyeong, at first wary and indifferent, begins to feel drawn to Su-Rim’s strange charm and hidden vulnerability. As the two navigate a maze of family politics, supernatural legacy, and growing attraction, their fates become more entangled than either of them expected. title: Fight Club
description:
Min-Chan has lived his whole life as part of the elite top 1%—an Alpha who always wins. Bored with his perfect life, he accepts a friend's invitation to join Fight Club, a brutal underground arena where only fighting skills matter. What starts as a casual thrill quickly escalates when Min-Chan begins competing himself—and winning easily, just like always. But just as victory starts to feel hollow, he faces an opponent he can't beat: Tae-Wook, a smaller, seemingly fragile Omega. Crushed by his first-ever defeat, Min-Chan is furious—and obsessed. He approaches Tae-Wook, only to be met with complete indifference, a blow to his pride he can't ignore. Then one night, fate strikes: Tae-Wook enters his heat cycle, and Min-Chan doesn’t miss his chance. Pride, instinct, and raw attraction collide—

In this fight, winning might mean losing everything Min-Chan thought he knew.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes eight extra chapters.*

title: Last Dot
description:
Ju-Won is a new hire in the product development team of a tea manufacturing company, quietly nursing a crush on his handsome and composed supervisor, Assistant Manager Yul. Content to admire from afar, Ju-Won keeps his feelings to himself—until one day, Yul suddenly frowns and asks, “Did someone wear perfume in the office?”

Ju-Won denies it, but Yul insists there’s a scent that only seems to linger when he’s around. Intrigued, Yul starts leaning in close, sniffing Ju-Won during every encounter under the guise of a “smell check.” What begins as an awkward misunderstanding turns into a daily ritual—one that leaves Ju-Won flustered, especially as his body begins to react to Yul’s warm breath and closeness. Caught between the sweetness of unspoken affection and the thrill of their strange new routine, Ju-Won wonders…

Could Yul be picking up more than just a scent?

(Source: Lezhin US)

tags_v2.name: Tsundere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are initially cold, hostile, or prickly toward others (especially love interests), but gradually or occasionally reveal a softer, warmer, or caring side beneath their abrasive exterior. The term is a combination of "tsun" (ツンツン, tsuntsun, aloof or prickly) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.name: Yandere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are deeply, obsessively in love, often to the point of violence, possessiveness, or psychosis. They may appear sweet, shy, or affectionate at first, but their devotion can lead them to extreme actions—including harming rivals, kidnapping, or even killing to protect or keep their love interest. The term is a combination of "yan" (ヤン, from yanderu, sick or mentally ill) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

title: Love on a Loop
description:
Kwon Yeong has been rejected by Yun Jeyeong six times, each dismissal wrapped in gibberish that he can't make out. But the real problem isn't just the heartbreak; it's that every time he's rejected, he's transported back to the first day of the new semester when he first met Jeyeong. Stuck in this endless cycle, Yeong's confessions always take him back to square one. Frustrated and fed up, Yeong declares, ""I'm not gonna like you anymore! Never again!"" Just when Yeong decides to give up, the loop restarts. But this time, something begins to change in their relationship. 

Dive into the mysterious and heartwarming journey of ""Love on a Loop,"" where every reset brings new possibilities for love and self-discovery.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: I Am a Scarecrow
description:
Lee Ho-Yeon, known in-game as "White Jack," starts playing the MMORPG Lunatic with a skilled friend but quits after struggling with controls and losing motivation. Years later, frustrated by repeated university entrance exams, he logs back in for stress relief and unexpectedly meets the game’s top-ranking player, Kim Hee-Ho ("Monaka").Despite his foul temper and aloof reputation, Hee-Ho helps Ho-Yeon improve. When Hee-Ho leaves his guild due to conflicts and joins "21," the small guild Ho-Yeon inherited, their ranking quickly rises. Rumors spread that they are dating since Hee-Ho is uncharacteristically warm toward Ho-Yeon.

To gain a game bonus, they register as an in-game couple, but no one believes it is just for the rewards. When a rival guild challenges them to a war, even the usually support-focused Ho-Yeon is forced to fight. He agrees to meet Hee-Ho offline for training but instead receives a real-life confession. They begin dating. The twist is that Ho-Yeon has been using a female avatar. When Hee-Ho proudly introduces his in-game partner, the truth comes out, sparking rumors that Ho-Yeon was pretending to be a girl.

What started as a game partnership turns into a real relationship. But between guild conflicts, public scrutiny, and real-life pressures, Ho-Yeon struggles to keep up. With Hee-Ho’s unwavering support, he fights to protect both their guild and their growing bond.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sierratica Tiar Yerphinen, my sworn enemy. I died by his sword... until I didn't?! 

Beatrice Shelle Marcean wakes up five years after the day of her death in a new kingdom—a new body, in a new family. Now living as princess Shroina, our female lead must do whatever it takes to push away from his pull. She won't repeat the same mistake twice.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

description:
In an era of chaos, with the throne left without a ruler, the five great houses fell into a brutal civil war for dominance. Enraged by the blood spilled in the name of ambition, the god cast a curse upon the foolish: the creation of Alpha and Omega traits. To seek forgiveness, the five great houses agreed to hold a hunting tournament and offer sacrifices to the god. Onyx, the newly crowned matriarch of the First House, finds herself deeply troubled by the upcoming tournament. Her nemesis, Kairo, the Alpha and patriarch of the Second House, has suddenly declared his intention to participate. For Onyx, who has risen as an Omega leader in a house that traditionally refuses to accept Omegas as heads, Kairo’s presence is far from welcome. Where will their clash, fueled by mutual hatred and undeniable attraction, ultimately lead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.*

description:
After losing his mother to the mafia, Ro-Wan goes undercover to destroy the organization from the inside. But things take an unexpected turn when he meets its enigmatic leader, Raphael Valentino…a man he should loathe, but can’t seem to ignore. Determined to bring the seedy underbelly of New York down - whether as Rafael’s hunting dog or as someone powerful enough to crush it from above - Ro-Wan spends years as a member of his gang. But the more time they spend together, the harder it becomes to draw the line between duty and desire. In a world built upon lies and vengeance, can this tangled relationship end in love…or will it all fall apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Winning the lottery and becoming a wealthy landlord overnight, he finally works up the courage to confess his feelings to his longtime crush. But there’s a catch—she’s only into men who wax. Determined to become her ideal type, Yun Hyeok heads to a waxing salon run by his old classmate, Lee Ha-eun. What starts as an awkward grooming session takes an unexpected turn when Ha-eun, noticing something…impressive, makes a shocking offer:

*"Would you like me to take care of this for you?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Yeon is the sole survivor of a devastating fire that took everything from her: her home, her status, and her family. Cast aside by the society she once called her own, she learns to survive in isolation, forging her own path. One stormy day, she is drawn by the sorrowful cries of an unusual creature, only to find a mysterious boy with snow-white hair and piercing amber eyes lying in the rain. She names him "Bibi," after the soft, sorrowful sounds he was making when she found him. Bibi remembers nothing of his past or how he came to be on earth…all he knows now is that he feels an undeniable connection to the sky, and a fierce determination to keep Yeon by his side by any means necessary. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
The Blooming estate was in an uproar when nineteen year old Rowena Blooming suddenly went missing, only to be discovered without any recollection of what happened. Rowena was the most confused, left with no memories, but the faint lingering traces of a feeling, or dream she had. Soon, she discovers that something else is lingering around her: a specter of a man who only she can see and hear that identifies itself as Enoch Claude, a member of the notorious Margraves house of Claude. Enoch also claims he is hailing from four years into the future, and is entangled with Rowena in this past timeline as an incorporeal spirit that can occasionally make contact with her, physically and emotionally. The caring Rowena attempts to help Enoch get back to his own life, while his presence as her guardian spirit grows stronger by day.
While the ghostly lord with a dark past is clearly hiding that the two of them are acquainted in the future on bad terms, he grows closer to the Rowena of the past, as they discover more about the reason for their entanglement. Why was Enoch sent back to be her guardian spirit? What is the secret he is hiding? What new future lies for this pair, divided by time? 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title: The Case of Doctor Agato
description:
Five years after the war, peace has settled over the victorious nation of Formapolis...until a strange series of incidents threatens to shatter it. Corpses with grotesque modifications, known only as "specimens," begin turning up in the capital. Detective Kleine, assigned to the case, is ordered to investigate every detail under the guidance of the state’s special security division. His assigned partner? Doctor Agato, a brilliant but secretive scientist from the defeated nation, whose charm seems as deliberate as it is disarming. 

As Kleine is drawn deeper into the mystery, he comes face to face with Tristan, a man with unnatural powers and a disturbing connection to Agato. The deeper the investigation goes, the more it becomes clear: this isn't just a case about dead bodies. It's a collision of past sins, buried experiments, and a bond too dangerous to name. 

*“I wanted to see you again, Professor.”* 

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Min Ji-Ho’s idol career as a member of a mid-tier K-pop group member ends in emotional turmoil and disappointment. When an awkward reunion with former groupmate Park Hyeon-Do pulls him back into old tensions, Ji-Ho is forced to confront not just his past, but the unresolved wounds he thought he left behind with his life as an idol. In a world where appearances are everything, can Jiho uncover what he truly wants…and who he wants to stand beside him when the cameras are off?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Ji Woo-In is a clumsy but good-hearted police officer in the Community Safety Division. At 28, he's still single, still a virgin, and constantly pressured by his family to start dating. description:
A man is found murdered in an apartment at 19 Sunset Street. The prime suspect is Leon Devonport, the victim's lover, and all evidence found on the scene of the death seem to point to him. In order to prove his innocence, Leon seeks out Benjamin Wolf, a once-famous detective who has now retired from murder cases due to an incident in his past. Benjamin had long stepped away from murder cases, but at Leon's desperate request, with a bit of flirting, he reluctantly takes the case and begins to investigate. As the investigation progresses, Benjamin uncovers hidden truths behind the case and the complex relationships between all parties involved. What is the truth hidden behind this "murder?" What is Leon hiding from Benjamin?

description:
Undercover NIS agent Park Seonwu is disguised as a café owner in an affluent neighborhood to investigate a drug ring. When he stumbles upon a lead about a drug-fueled party, he infiltrates it under the guise of delivering coffee. Realizing that Yohan might have crucial information about the case, Seonwu seeks his help. Yohan, attracted to Seonwu, agrees on the condition that they become friends with benefits. Their unconventional relationship deepens, but as the investigation nears its end, Yohan abruptly cuts ties with Seonwu and seemingly dies in a car accident, leaving Seonwu heartbroken. Three years later, Seonwu, now hardened by his past, spots Yohan in footage from a new NIS sting—alive and well, under the alias "Yohan Romanov," a notorious Russian mafia member. Fueled by betrayal and unresolved trauma, Seonwu embarks on a mission to Russia, determined to confront the man who shattered his world.

description:
*"Mr. Hyde, I'm getting married."*

Hyde, a cold and love-averse individual, is tasked by the prince to go undercover as the tutor of Lily, the adopted daughter of Viscount Bardin, to uncover clues about illegal firearm trafficking.

*"And who will be the lucky gentleman to take your hand in marriage, my lady?"*

*"Lord Lucien Sornell, the first son of Count Sornell. Are you perhaps acquainted with him?"*

During his mission, Hyde discovers that his innocent and demure pupil, Lily, is engaged to Lucien, a notorious rake in high society. Ahh, yes. She's been adopted to be married off, so I guess now is when she comes in handy.

*"Mr. Hyde, what do you think the lord likes in a woman?"*

With her big, innocent eyes, Lily looks so pure, yet she has the delicate beauty of a painting. Her body is frail, yet she is well-developed in all the right places, and utterly adorable. For just one week, she vows to become the most beloved bride.

*"Mr. Hyde, if it’s not too much trouble, will you teach me how to do it?"*

*"Of course, Lady Lily. Teaching you is the greatest joy and pleasure I've known in life."*

Though Hyde despises getting his hands dirty and is in a constant rivalry with Lucien, he decides to masquerade as a genuine tutor, teaching Lily the refined ways of noble romance to give Lucien a taste of his own medicine. Will Hyde’s lessons turn Lily into the perfect bride, or will they uncover deeper, more dangerous secrets?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
After years of obscurity, rising star Sung Yi-Hyun is finally basking in the spotlight... Conquering dramas, variety shows, and the glitz of celebrity life. Then one day, he gets a single text from his longtime lover, Jang Tae-Eun:

 *“Let’s break up.”*

 *“Don’t tell me… he’s seeing someone else?”*

When Yi-Hyun storms over to confront him, he's greeted not by his ex—but by the biggest, brightest full moon he’s ever seen. And just like that, the secret he’s kept hidden for years is exposed… along with a tail and a pair of ears. Mistaken for a stray and taken in by Tae-Eun, Yi-Hyun suddenly finds himself living under the same roof as his ex— not as a man, but as a dog named Rufus. 

A sweet ex, a secret shifter, and one very suspiciously adorable dog— let the dangerously cute cohabitation begin!

Mirabel is a famed mercenary whose mother, Cornelia, had long suffered from the guilt of leaving her family, the Grand Dukedom of Criton behind. After Cornelia's failed attempts to contact her family left her distressed and led to her death, Mirable sought revenge, tracking down her grandfather, the Grand Duke Criton, and the assumed cause of all her mother's misery. After finding out that he too was betrayed, Mirabel meets an untimely death at the hands of the true culprit, only to wake up back when she was nine years old, with her mother still alive.

Determined to stop her mother's death, and seek revenge against the true villain, Mirabel sets out to make things right. But her choice to meet her grandfather makes her cross traces of her past, while she experiences a life she never knew before.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title: Down the Rabbit Hole
description:
"Why does the Dragon King seek a rabbit?

Cheong-wan, a turtle from the Dragon King’s palace, ventures onto land to retrieve the liver of a rabbit to cure the ailing king. By sheer luck, he encounters the elusive rabbit almost immediately upon arrival. Determined to bring the rabbit back to the Underwater Kingdom, Cheong-wan is prepared to do whatever it takes. 

""And how will you convince me?""
""Sorry?""
""If I go to the Dragon King's palace, what will you do for me in return, Cheong-wan?"" 

Cheong-wan finds himself mesmerized by the rabbit Jeok-ran's playful smile and enigmatic words. He realizes that to succeed, he must go to far lengths. 

Thus begins a perilous and enchanting journey, as Cheong-wan navigates a world filled with unexpected challenges and mysterious allurements, where the stakes are as high as the depths of the Dragon King's palace."

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Alicia Sorcelion is a Noble Lady of the Empire, whose only sin was believing in love. When a doctored prophecy matches her likeness, Prelate Libenthius, a religious leader of the Empire's Central Pantheon, conspires to take advantage of Alicia, puppeting her as the "Saintess" of the empire and betrothing her to the Crown Prince, Viktor Lawrence. 

While she is praised by the masses,she conceals her apparent lack of divine power, and lives a secluded and lonely life, only finding solace in her love for Viktor, who she believes to reciprocate her feelings. After ViKtor becomes Emperor, he reveals that he too was using her as a pawn in his ambitious plans, and with the appearance of a new "True Saintess" appears, Alicia is branded as a traitor and "False Saintess" in the eyes of the public, eventually sentenced to burn at the stake as a witch and traitor of the Empire. 

Given another chance at life from the heavens, she opens her eyes in the past, with evidence of living a tragic future branded on her. Determined to avoid the prophecy at all costs, she aims to become a religious servant of the Empire, immune to the prophecy and the influence of her traitors. However her journey is not so easy, as her fate is tangled with a helping Cleric, Edwin, and her past tormentors continue to enact their conspiracy from her past future. 

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

But one night, while Ah-Yeong is distracted prepping dinner, Wujin accidentally knocks over a box—and out rolls a very intimate gift from her friend: a dildo. description:
In a world where interdimensional gates unleash monstrous threats, a rare few are born with extraordinary powers. These gifted individuals are known as Espers and Guides. Choi Kyuhyuk is officially classified as an S-class Esper, but there’s a catch. His self-regeneration ability is so weak that he's been downgraded to S-minus. People call him a “half-baked” Esper, and the name has stuck ever since. After sustaining a serious injury, he has been reassigned to a desk job in the Guide Line Department, where he now trains rookie Guides. Life was relatively peaceful until one very specific problem arrived. Yeon Soo-Jung, a Guide Kyuhyuk once saved as a child and treats like family, has just come of age. And now, he wants to initiate a sex guiding session with Kyuhyuk. Worse still, Soojung makes his intent painfully clear:

 *“Just sleep with me once. Let me give you the sex guiding, please.”*

Sure, guiding is essential for Espers to stabilize their powers. But the idea of doing it with him sends Kyuhyuk into full panic mode. 

 *“Wait, Soo-Jung. I'm really not mentally prepared for this yet...”

“But sir, your erection says otherwise.”*

Caught between professional ethics and personal chaos, Kyuhyuk now faces the most awkward guiding session of his life. And it’s with the one person he never expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes four side story chapters.*

In a world where malevolent spirits roam freely, Jeong Wol has spent his entire life pretending not to see them. Is this second life a blessing that spared him from death, or a curse that will drag him deeper into the serpent’s shadow?

unknown.title: アウトサイド・ザ・ドア〜お前が扉を開ける時〜

description:
Reclusive and withdrawn, Tae-jeong has spent years shut away from the world, surviving in the quiet suffocation of his own room. But when his father is suddenly hospitalized due to a car accident, even that fragile isolation begins to crumble. Grief and fear twist together inside him, leaving only one outlet, an uneasy rush of desire that both calms and consumes him. 

Enter Eun-won, the golden boy who has everything Tae-jeong doesn’t: confidence, charm, a life untouched by loneliness. He looks at Tae-jeong with disdain, pity, and something darker, an attraction he refuses to name. As the line between disgust and desire blurs, both are drawn into a dangerous intimacy born from guilt, curiosity, and longing. 

What begins as comfort becomes compulsion, and behind locked doors, Tae-jeong and Eun-won learn that even the most broken hearts can crave, and destroy, in the same breath.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Jae-Ui and Mu-Yeong, used to be in the same club but grew apart until they unexpectedly crossed paths nearly ten years after graduation. Despite Jae-Ui’s cold demeanor, Mu-Yeong persistently tries to bridge the gap between them. description:
Jin Yeong-Won, an unregistered special forces sergeant, has deliberately avoided using his abilities as a Sentinel for years. But when his hidden power is exposed, he is forcibly transferred into a classified unit where Sentinels are weapons, not choices. There, Yeong-Won meets Captain Myeong Hae-Jun, an A-rank Guide assigned to stabilize him. From the start, Yeong-Won resists, haunted by the trauma of the day his powers first awakened. He refuses to fight as a Sentinel, believing that using his ability again will only drag him back into that nightmare. Command does not agree. Orders come down for Hae-Jun to deploy Yeong-Won into active combat, regardless of his condition. Then one night, air raid sirens pierce the base. As explosions echo overhead, Yeong-Won is thrown back seven years, forced to relive the moment that broke him. 

With danger closing in and trust still unformed, both men must decide whether survival is possible without confronting the past head-on. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.*

Bound by that rare act of grace, Tae-Shin reluctantly postpones Yoon’s death. To justify this decision, Tae-Shin appoints Yoon as his temporary assistant. As the line between duty and desire blurs, both man and reaper are forced to confront their past, their bond, and the strange pull growing between them in the space between life and death.

title: PREDATOR
description:
Kail Black, a soldier stationed at an Antarctic research base, is assigned to support investigations into unexplained supernatural phenomena. But one morning, he wakes to a nightmare. The base has been overrun by monstrous organisms, and everyone is gone except for one man, Revo Keypling, who calmly introduces himself as a researcher. With no memory of what happened, Kail struggles to understand the disaster unfolding around them. But something even more disturbing begins to haunt him. Every night, he dreams of Revo, their bodies intertwined like wild animals, the visions so vivid that they leave him breathless when he wakes. And in those dreams, Revo always whispers the same chilling line, “Right here, this is where our baby will be born.” 

Trapped in an isolated base, surrounded by impossible creatures, Kail begins to wonder which is more dangerous, the things lurking outside, or the man smiling beside him with secrets of his own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
One day, I realized I had been reincarnated as the protagonist’s friend in a tragic novel—one where I was doomed to die while trying to save the heroine. Determined to change my fate, I decided to tell the heroine everything… but for some reason, my words were censored, as if the universe itself was blocking spoilers! Frustrated, I stormed into the forbidden forest and shouted my secrets into the void—venting my anger at the male lead while I was at it. It should’ve been fine. No one was supposed to hear me. Yet somehow, rumors spread like wildfire that the powerful Duke Vishvaltz was… into men?! Now, he’s launching a full-blown investigation to find the source of the absurd gossip.

*“…Your voice is quite unforgettable.”*

…Yep. My life is officially over.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Precious Thing
description:
Ji Geon-Woo has been a thief since childhood, surviving with quick hands and sharp instincts. He isn’t greedy, stealing is simply a means to an end. One day, he sets his sights on a priceless necklace owned by Lee Ye-Shin, a troubled rich heir. To get close, Geon-Woo infiltrates Ye-Shin’s home as a bodyguard. At first, Ye-Shin appears reckless and self-indulgent, but Geon-Woo soon realizes he is deeply lonely, suffering from chronic insomnia. As their relationship blurs, Ye-Shin grows possessive, and Geon-Woo finds himself wanting to protect him, rather than just stealing from him. But when Ye-Shin discovers Geon-Woo’s true intentions, their fragile connection shatters. Now, Geon-Woo must make a choice, walk away with the necklace or stay for Ye-Shin. Meanwhile, Ye-Shin realizes that the only thing he truly wants isn't wealth, but Geon-Woo himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Control Time

unknown.title: Control Time：コントロール・タイム

description:
Raymon has it all: perfect looks, a prestigious family, and unrivaled abilities in the workplace. But beneath his flawless exterior lies a chaotic love life, with a string of unsatisfying, fleeting encounters. His search for the perfect partner ends when a janitor named Winter seemingly saves him from a stalker's attack. Drawn to Winter’s striking looks and submissive nature, Raymon proposes a FWB situation, to which Winter eagerly agrees. At first, their relationship seems ideal, but Raymon soon realizes the terrifying truth - Winter has been his stalker all along. Now trapped in a deadly game, Raymon finds himself pretending to love Winter in a desperate bid to survive. Winter, unhinged and obsessively devoted, will stop at nothing - even murder - to keep Raymon all to himself. And so begins a dangerous, seductive battle of control, where love and dominance blur into a deadly obsession. 

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Includes five extra chapters.*

description:
Our female lead had the martial arts skills to beat down any man, but never had the chance to date or even touch a man in her past life. After an untimely death, she is transmigrated into the childhood body of Iona, a noble lady in a Fantasy Romance novel world, where her fate is to wed and live with one man. 

 *"No way! This time, I'm dating around!"* 

Determined to escape marriage, she befriends a crying boy she finds in her garden who shares a similar fate, and light-heartedly agrees to marry him to cheer him up. After Iona is all grown up and ready to mingle with all the gorgeous men in the empire, a certificate of engagement finds her, showing that she is already engaged to none other than Carvain Tenebreth, the ninth crown prince of the empire. The crying boy had scammed him into becoming his Crown Princess! 

Iona, even running away from home, pushes for divorce, while her obsessive husband is hot on her tail, determined to wife her. Will Iona be able to enjoy a free love life, or end up tied to her obsessive prince for life? 

(Source: Pocket Comics)

*Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.*

But this time is different.

Now, Jaejin knows exactly how Seo Wui-wu thinks, what moves him, and—most importantly—how to control him. With the promise of guiding as bait, Seo Wui-wu will be his to manipulate.

As Seo Wui-wu’s breath grows heavy and his dark hair falls messily over his forehead, his hungry gaze flashes with dangerous excitement.

Who will truly hold the reins in this second chance at fate?"

title: My Friend Kim Jong Un
description:
Award-winning cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim demystifies the inscrutable North Korean leader 

A woman falls over a thin black line, slicing her in two—half becoming North Korea, the other half becoming South. From the Island of Ganghwa, a seemingly idyllic rural paradise just an hour outside of Seoul, North Korea sits mere miles away, visible from cartoonist Keum Suk Gendry-Kim’s home and studio. It looms over her while she walks her dogs through the rice paddies. Artillery fire, helicopters, and sirens from a nearby military base paint her acoustic landscape. Gendry-Kim has written extensively about the pain and heartbreak experienced throughout Korea’s recent history in her award-winning books Grass and The Waiting. In My friend Kim Jong-Un, Gendry-Kim looks not to the past, but to the present—to the man currently responsible for upholding the national divide. 

Retracing his rise to power and uncovering his human side, Gendry-Kim explores the life of the supreme leader of the Democratic People’s Republic of Korea: from his birth to his international education, his tastes and hobbies, and his relationships. Gendry-Kim weaves her personal accounts from this process throughout the book, in her signature approach to personal nonfiction by including interviews with former South Korean president Moon Jae-in, North Korean defectors, researchers, journalists, Kim’s former chef, and a friend from his boarding school days in Switzerland. 

My Friend Kim Jong-Un carries a message of peace and attempts to make sense of an awful chapter in Korean history. Translated by the award-winning Janet Hong, My Friend… is a cautionary tale and education on what makes a dictator, at a time when these lessons are more relevant in the West than ever. 

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

title: Dating 101
description:
*“Once I grow up, I am going to marry you, Yi-Chan!”*

From childhood, Seo Eu-Na adored his next door neighbor Kang Yi-Chan with absolute devotion. He followed him everywhere, chased off anyone who tried to get close to him, regardless of whether they were male or female, and declared him his future husband to anyone who would listen. To Yi-Chan, he was just a clingy little brother figure, unbearably persistent and impossible to shake off. So the moment he entered university, he disappeared from Eu-Na's life entirely, convinced he had finally escaped. Three years pass, and Yi-Chan returns from military service relieved that the nightmare is over. Until the first day of class. There, in his major lecture, sits a bright eyed freshman, smiling directly at him. Seo Eu-Na. He has grown up, followed him to the same university, and looks more determined than ever. This time, Yi-Chan might not be able to run.

(Source: Lezhin US)

What started as a challenge—payback for the man who once crushed my pride—quickly turns into something far more dangerous. This time, who will be the one in control? Let’s find out.

description:

Enoch Milligan, a charming Hollywood heartthrob known more for his looks than his acting skills, is desperate to prove himself as more than just a pretty face. Enoch is cast as the lead in a movie based on Nan-Woo’s life and insists on shadowing him to prepare for the role, ignoring Nan-Woo’s initial discomfort. As Enoch stays by his side—warm, passionate, and unexpectedly gentle—Nan-Woo’s walls slowly begin to crack. The closer they grow, the more Nan-Woo begins to rediscover beauty, trust, and a light he thought he’d lost forever. Sometimes, healing begins with simply letting someone in.

title: Jimseungui Nagwon
description:
For an orphan, Lee Goyo is a lucky child. She was rescued along with a prosecutor’s son in a kidnapping 14 years ago and became the adopted daughter of ex-prosecutor Lee Uitaek. However, she didn’t have a sweet life, but a life of hellfire. In exchange for being with Lee Uitaek and his son, she became their doll and dog. 

“Lee Uitaek told me to seduce you.”

 “If I tease you, will you come?”

 “What do you think we’ll do all night long?”

 “…I guess I was thinking too grandly. In the end, it was just going to be a meaningless night.”

 In order to survive, she had to continue proving her worth even if it meant seducing KJ Finance’s president, Kwon Jaeheon, a man she had no relationship with. 

 “What I want is… A life of freedom. 

No matter how hard she struggled, she couldn’t escape that hell on her own.

 “Promise me one thing. Promise that you’ll save me from them.”

 I would even eat a poisoned apple.

 “I told you that I’d give it to you even if it killed me. Don’t you trust me?”

 At that moment, that crazy and dangerous man seemed like a savior leading her to paradise in Goyo’s eyes.

description:
Elijah is the almighty god of plants, but due to false accusation ends up being imprisoned in a cell for 200 years. Expecting the life in the novel to be much easier, he was in for a rude awakening. He finds out that Roselita did not commit suicide by drinking poison, and aims to find her name and clear her reputation in the meantime. 

*“Aak! Who are you, really?!”

“Me? I’m the fairy of the mallet who protects love and justice.”

* And he’s going to have a fateful love that he’s only seen in dramas and novels!

*“No one will ever point fingers at you again.”
*
The Derman family, especially her uncle Benjamin, can’t stand it even if I move a finger. Damn it. This is the first time I’ve felt this kind of affection! And to top it all off, the broken-down crown prince is my fiancé…? What about my romance? My fateful love!?

title: Twin Moon
description:
A woman identical to me appears in my dreams, crying. 

“Who are you?”

For three years, Shunaelle, the Demon King of the North, has been haunted by the same dream, growing curious about the woman and deciding to track her down. 

The truth? 

She’s a fragment of Shunaelle’s soul, cast away into the human realm. When Shunaelle tries to absorb the fragment back into herself, the woman resists. 

『I don’t want to be absorbed!』 

Instead, she makes a plea: If you want me back, live my life—a life filled with regret—and make it right.

title: Finally, the Dawn Came
description:
After eight years, Duke Erte returned to his homeland as a hero. He returned with glory and honor, but all he really wanted was revenge. Revenge for the wife no one remembers. "Rise," who gave her life to protect him to the end.

 "Will you help me?" 

And for revenge he needed a woman. A woman to prove his status as an "adult" of age so he could trample on the pride of those conceited nobles. In that sense, this woman was a good fit. 

"Be my woman." 

She was a refugee who had lost her home and was working alone to raise her daughter. The only thing about her that resembled his wife was her name, "Rise." But the more time he spent with her, the more the young duke began to realize something. Her resemblance didn't end with just her name. description:
Ecologist Nang Se-Hyeon discovers traces of poachers while conducting a bird watching in a deep mountain that she has been doing every year since late autumn. She expresses her concerns and suddenly encounters Kang Ji-Ah. Se-Hyeon mistakes Ji-Ah for a poacher and attacks her with pepper spray, but Ji-Ah claims that she is an official hunter who has received permission from the mountain owner to hunt harmful birds. However, he loses her pouch containing her permit and contact information after rolling down the mountain path, so there is no way to confirm her identity. Se-Hyeon becomes anxious, suspecting Ji-Ah’s true identity. Since the mountain is far from a base station, cell phones do not work well, and it takes a whole day to get to a house, she cannot send Ji-Ah back immediately. In the end, Se-Hyeon decides to stay with Ji-Ah until she recovers while still being suspicious. Ji-Ah follows Se-Hyeon around as she continues to observe birds, and begins to show curiosity about her work.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: Murim Instructor at Marriageable Age
description:
This Life, I Will Succeed

A mountain of corpses, a sea of blood.
At the summit, only two people remained.

"Why did you save me?"
"At last... you're looking at me."
"I'll ask again. Why did you save me?"

The man was curious.
It was natural.
The woman was his sworn enemy.
And their rivalry should have ended there.
The final act was to be his death.
Those he believed were his subordinates stabbed him in the back, and even more enemies rushed to target him.

"Answer me. Why did you keep me alive!"

"Don't cry..."

"Am I... crying?"

Hot tears were flowing from eyes he thought had dried up long ago.

"Just think of it as a bad dream. A very painful and terrible dream."
"But if our time together held any value at all."
"Even at the end of this nightmare, please find me again."

Thump thump thump thump.
The mountain of corpses began to rumble.
Simultaneously, beyond the blood-red earth, numerous flags rose amidst a hazy dust.

"Uaaaaaah!"
The man roared upon seeing the massive blood-colored flag.

"Mangcheon Assembly! I won't let you get away with this."

Will Cho Un-hwi, who has been given a new life, be able to find his bride-to-be?

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/63914843), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%EA%B2%B0%ED%98%BC%EC%A0%81%EB%A0%B9%EA%B8%B0-%EB%AC%B4%EB%A6%BC%EA%B5%90%EA%B4%80/4026)

title: Heavenly Demon Tavern
description:
One day, Joo Kang-hyun, a stranger who fell into the world of martial arts, rose to the position of Heavenly Demon after going through countless hardships. However, he always missed his hometown, the 21st-century Republic of Korea. He thought he would return to his hometown once the proper array was activated, but instead, he regressed to the past.

Gosh… The Heavenly Demon, Joo Kang-hyun, went back in time! In order to save the Youngrae Tavern, which was on the verge of bankruptcy, he cooked delicious Jajangmyeon and Jjamppong! This tavern was the place where he lived with the three siblings who took care of him when he first entered Murim, Soran, Doran, and Unyoung. Although their business was not going well, they lived happily in their own way. In the future, after he became the Heavenly Demon, he heard news that their lives all ended miserably. He planned to stop their misfortunes himself. How? With Future Vision, Demon Lord Qi, and Jajangmyeon!

*Jinbeob: This is a term in the murim world that means ‘formation/array’ which in some cases refers to the formations used by soldiers or groups of people in battle, but in some cases it also refers to formations used to distort space to manipulate the opponent’s mind and make the opponent fall into the illusion desired by the attacker, we can also call it a ‘hidden space’

description:
I need to get married. But men aren't exactly lining up to meet me, and there aren't many prospects in this small town. 

Actually, there is one.
My childhood friend, Cha I-hyeok.
He whispers in my ear in a devilish tone. 

“I guess you don't have a choice, you'll have to marry me.”
Is he a man? Sure. He's a good-looking guy, but we're like family. 

“Are you crazy? No. I can't marry you.”
“Why not?”
“If we get married, we'll have to do... things at night. How can we do that with you and me?”
“Well, we can try it out.”
“Try what?”
“Kiss… or have sex.” 

Before I could scold him for his insanity, I-hyeok kisses my lips roughly.
The moist, hot feeling is unfamiliar.
His lips, nibbling on mine, swells slightly.
And it's not just his lips that's swelling. I can feel him get hard, pressing against my flesh. 

“Huh....”
We are friends.
No…
We were friends.
Friends don't kiss like this. 

What are we now, then?

title: Murim-chepojeondamjo
description:
Stop the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, a group seeking to rule the world through demons! 

Late at night, in a noisy gambling house, a ruffian bets on the family's stolen sword. The legendary Seven-Star Sword, said to control demons, is revealed. Moments later, the Sinwolmun's disciple, Sacheonpaehwang, appears from nowhere. The gambling house is devastated, corpses strewn about. Since that day, the martial arts world has been plagued by a series of gruesome and brutal incidents. The Inryungjo, a martial arts investigation agency specializing in arresting unsolved cases, is dispatched to the scene of these unsolved cases. Recognizing the emergence of a vast dark force, they hunt down its source. Meanwhile, Hui-Yeon, disguised as a man and joining the Inryungjo to avenge her family, is caught on the first day by the group's leader, Beom-Yeop. However, for some reason, Beom-Yeop forces Hui-yeon to remain in the Inryungjo.

Can the Inryungjo prevent the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, once thought lost to legend?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: A Drop So Inconsequential
description:
Teddy Magazine editorial intern, Yoo Ji-yoo.
One day, right before the magazine's deadline, the main article falls through.
Then comes a special mission from the editor-in-chief, notoriously known as the "witch."

The task? An exclusive interview with the photographer Jake (JAKE), who is secretly returning to Korea!
But at the airport, the Jake I meet is someone I know...

"Do-hyung oppa?"
"And you're just standing there while I'm about to be devoured by the witch?"

His familiar low voice and signature musky scent.
But unlike before, everything about him feels awkward.
When he speaks to me or his touch brushes against me, my toes tingle for some reason.

When he beckons me with a playful smile, asking why I’m not coming into his arms already,
at that moment, he is no longer just "my brother’s friend."

"You’re so cute when you talk."
"…Uh. What should I say to that?"
"You’re so beautiful I want to kiss you."

Yoo Ji-yoo’s sweet romance with the dangerous Seo Do-hyung and her one and only drop.

[Original Webtoon](https://page.kakao.com/content/63733643)

**Official Translations:**  
[Japanese](https://jp.piccoma.com/web/product/167860)

unknown.title: モーテル・カリフォルニア

description:
Can love and life be remodeled?

Our heroine, Ji Kanghee, was born and raised in a motel.
She hates the small rural town where everyone is like family, so she leaves behind her first love, Cheon Yeonsu, and escapes.

After years of struggling, falling, and climbing back up, she finally feels like she's found success, a career, and maybe even love. But then, she hears a rumor—her first love, Yeonsu, the one she thought would long for her forever, has found someone to marry.

From the depths of her heart, she sends him a sincere blessing, but she can’t shake the overwhelming urge to confirm it for herself.
Does this girlfriend really exist? And what are Yeonsu's true feelings?

By a twist of fate, the construction site where she's now the project lead is located in H-town, the very place she swore she’d never return to after leaving.
Amid interactions with old classmates and townsfolk, she starts to sense that Yeonsu might still have feelings for her—and to her surprise, she doesn’t entirely dislike it.

Before she knows it, both her love and her life are undergoing a full remodel.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/65626190), [Daum](https://webtoon.kakao.com/content/%ED%99%88-%EB%B9%84%ED%84%B0-%ED%99%88-%EB%AA%A8%ED%85%94-%EC%BA%98%EB%A6%AC%ED%8F%AC%EB%8B%88%EC%95%84/4342)

title: Lullaby
description:
Image consultant Jess Han, a troublemaker in Hollywood who specializes in saving irredeemable losers. Jess, who has lived his 30 years with nothing but pride, passion, and competitive spirit, has a new request from the hotel industry king Luke Leonard, who is suffering from scandal. It was okay that he decided to take on his work at the request of his close friend Alan. This man is surprisingly a formidable opponent. Jess, who has lived his whole life with his wits, is also dragged around by Luke, who has a dirty personality, unlike his known image. As he runs, flies, hangs upside down, gets a nosebleed, and eventually falls from the second floor while dreaming of revenge, Luke and he fight like a war every day, but at some point, a strange atmosphere begins to flow, and when he comes to his senses, they are kissing, and when he comes to his senses, (Luke) is saying that they are dating...

*“Sorry to ask, but… Do you know who my lover is?”*

For a moment, he is shocked by the love affair that began without him knowing, but he suddenly enters full-blown love mode, but at that moment, the whole story of the tragedy that happened to the Leonard family is revealed... 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: Tensegrity
description:
I thought I would be born a beta male and live an ordinary life until I suddenly manifested as an omega. After living my life that changed completely overnight, I gave up judo, which was so precious to me, and became the exclusive bodyguard for an omega family. Even so, I thought I would live quietly like this and die. Until I got into an accident with my employer’s son. No, until I realized that I got pregnant because of that one incident.

 *“Is there anyone else besides us who knows this?”*

Before I could even accept the fact that I was pregnant, the person proposed to me as calmly as if offering me a glass of water. 

 *“Mr. Ho Jun-Kyung, will you marry me?”*

The problem is that the person proposing is not the child’s biological father, but his older brother. Jun-Kyung’s life, which had been ordinary, becomes a drama overnight when it becomes entangled with him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: Bangeoneun Sarangeul Sitgo
description:
Cheol-Yong, who has been struggling to become an idol with his extraordinary talent since he was young. However, after repeated failures, he has come to terms with reality and is now working part-time at a sushi restaurant. He meets famous composer Ruth at a house where he went to deliver fish by chance, and while he thought he would get a chance, he ended up getting entangled in a bad relationship instead. Cheol-Yong is in a situation where he could end up getting sued because Ruth, who was composing music on his clothes, suddenly starts to touch him and hits his head with a trophy. Not only that, Ruth continues to make disparaging remarks, which is really annoying. This is a do-or-die situation. An angry Cheol-Yong hands out a 'Singing Contest' poster. He proposes to Ruth that if he wins, he will not sue him and that he should give him a song. On the day of the final battle, when Cheol-Yong sharpens his sword, goes up on stage, sings, and comes down, Ruth says... "I will sue you." Instead of saying, "I will make you a star. A trot star!" Trot?! Me, who was an idol trainee?!

title: The Substitute Chief Mourner
description:
If you have lingering attachments to this world, you can't rest in peace even after death. Knowing this, Sang-joo Kim uses his gift to see ghosts to help the deceased let go of their attachments and rest in peace as a soul guide. He also acts as a substitute chief mourner for unclaimed deceased individuals in public funerals. Sang-joo Kim tries to help Hyun-woo Nam, a high school senior for whom he acted as a substitute chief mourner, rest in peace. Under the condition that one must express their honest feelings verbally to let go of attachments and rest in peace, Hyun-woo can't achieve it because, unlike others, he doesn't even know what his attachment is. Opposite to Hyun-woo is Ji-woo Lee, Sang-joo's first love and long-time shadow. Even after death, Ji-woo lingers around Sang-joo, wanting to remain his one and only love. The intertwined story of Sang-joo Kim, the substitute chief mourner, and the two ghosts who can't rest in peace, Ji-woo Lee and Hyun-woo Nam.

description:
The One-Night Stand with the Insatiable Count Wasn’t Just a Dream! 

I found myself transmigrated into the body of the villainous mother-in-law from a novel—one who gets divorced by her Count husband for her vicious behavior, torments the future Queen, and ends up executed. Even if the plot’s cliché, I’m not about to die. Life is precious, after all. 

“I’ll gladly do it! That silly divorce!” 

I rushed to get the divorce finalized and stamped. Next comes the redemption arc, right? 

I greeted the female lead daughter-in-law with open arms. And finally, it’s only right to wish her the best when I leave. Since I know how the story ends, the path to becoming a conglomerate heiress is wide open. The time had come for me to shout, “Goodbye, everyone!” 

But then— 

“Mother! I love you! I can’t live without you!” 

Why is the daughter-in-law like this? 

“My lady, the purpose of the divorce reflection period is to thoroughly consider whether divorce is truly necessary.” 

And now even the husband seems strange? Then came the doctor’s diagnosis, the final straw that forced me to run away.

description:
A bold offer from the burly, innocent loan shark Jeong Hyeok-Su to the slender college student Lee Eun-Hu! 50 in one go! What should he do? Jun-Hu, Eun-Hu's troublemaker younger brother, is in big trouble this time. He borrowed money from a loan shark and couldn't pay it back! No matter how much he pays, there is no end in sight, and Eun-Hu is struggling, so Hyeok-Su makes a secret offer...

Black hair. Black eyes. 

Seiren, a girl who bears an uncanny resemblance to the legendary mermaid—long whispered to be a symbol of misfortune—is captured and offered to Madat as tribute.

Clever, cunning, and unlike anyone he’s ever encountered, Seiren captivates Madat. So, he chooses her. ---

description:
Sitting on the school yard, gazing at the sky, outside the window during class, waiting for a friend at the bus stop—love came unexpectedly. A sweet love story of two boys who are having a fling.

1. Jin-Woo and Young-Won: Jin-Woo, a good cook, a conceited, affectionate prisoner, and tactless, has grown listless in his dull daily life. Then, he falls in love at first sight with Young-Won, a senior he meets on school yard. However, Young-Won, everyone's idol, is already famous for his sharp rejection of confessions. It's only natural that if he, a stranger, confesses, he'll be 100% rejected! Jin-Woo decides to use his specialty, cooking, to tame Young-Won's stomach. Jin-Woo's "From Everyone's Senior to My Young-Won Project" ends in a mess. 

2. Tae-Heon and Ah-Seong: A conscious, introverted, tactless, and a gold digger. Tae-Heon's childhood friend Ah-Seong has a penchant for falling in love easily, regardless of gender. Falling in love faster than anyone else, feeling heartbroken faster than anyone else. Tae-Heon, who knew every detail of Ah-Seong's love life, suddenly had a question.

 *"Hey, but why do you fall for everyone but not me?"*

Tae-Heon confidently offered to make Ah-Seong fall for him, despite Ah-Seong's disapproval. Ah-Seong couldn't understand why he was acting like that...

description:
Do Woo-Jin, a bassist in an indie band, was an oddball with a strangely gloomy aura—and an almost absurd amount of bad luck. After his previous bands disbanded one after another, leaving him with nowhere to go, a third chance finally came his way. It was in this new band that he met Choi Hui-Su…

During a post-practice drinking session, while the band members chatted boisterously, Woo-Jin answered half-heartedly with an uncomfortable expression—until his gaze landed on Hui-Su’s tattoo.

*“…A pentagram symbolizes the devil.”*

For the first time, a spark of interest flickered in Woo-Jin’s otherwise empty eyes. But wait, what had their bandmate said while introducing Woo-Jin earlier?

*"I warned you, didn’t I? That guy’s a total nutcase."*

In a world where powerful nations dominate the weak, the Korean Empire managed to survive as an independent country. Among its royal family was Lee Dojae, the empire’s third prince, whose royal blood prevented him from pursuing his dream of becoming a singer.

Raised under the strict belief that he must always maintain dignity, honor, and usefulness, Dojae grew increasingly suffocated by a life controlled by duty rather than his own desires. Despite his status, he felt like a mere piece of floating debris—alive, yet unable to truly live.

One night, overwhelmed by years of suppressed emotions, Dojae finally confessed to himself that he wanted to become a singer. But suddenly, the television showed another version of himself saying the opposite: “I want to die. I don’t want to be a singer anymore.”

Confused and shocked by the mysterious reflection, Dojae tried to stand—but collapsed.

When he regained consciousness, he discovered that he was no longer Lee Dojae, the third prince of the Korean Empire. He had somehow become Kang Dojae, an ordinary person living in the Republic of Korea, opening the door to a completely different life and the possibility of finally pursuing his dream.

title: The Villainous Princess Saves the Doomed Knights (Pre-serialization)

The Villainous Princess Saves the Doomed Knights (Pre-serialization)
Villainous Princess Saves the Doomed Knights (Pre-serialization)

description:
I transmigrated into a fantasy novel where the male protagonist, in his attempt to save the world, loses his comrades one by one, leading to eventual destruction. My role is a villainous princess with an excessively innocent mind. I obsess over the male lead, pick fights, and eventually die in a demon attack, thus plunging the reputation of the knight order the male lead belongs to into ruin... 

'Oh, this isn't a knight order, it's a rabble!' I looked around at the disheveled knights with a dumbfounded expression. 

"Sir, Are you properly contracted? What about overtime pay? Is there any compensation in case of accidents? How about medical support for mental stress and physical injuries?"  
"Why are you suddenly asking this, Your Highness?" The male lead asked me suspiciously. Well, I once obsessively pursued him, so I understand his wariness.   
"You should call me 'Administrator' instead of 'Your Highness'."   
"No, that's..."   
"Kashia Astrid, as of today, you've been assigned as the administrative supply officer for the Azure Radiance Knights." I smiled sweetly at the bewildered male lead.   
"Also, please rest assured, I'll no longer obsess over you anymore." His looks? Obsession? Sweet and bitter romance? What use are those when the world is on the brink of destruction!   
"If you keep this up, I might accidentally send a letter of complaint to the Emperor about this matter." Playing the villainess, I even slapped him in the commander's office.   
"Hey, do you want us to wash your socks too? Do you lose your hands? Huh?" I even confronted the absurd military culture.   
"Don't be discouraged, it's not your fault." I comforted the mentally shattered future saviors. 

"Hurrah for the Administrative Supply Officer!"   
"You're our savior!"   
"Hail, Kashia!"

Wouldn’t two guys be better than one?

description:
A demon cult known as "Magyo" pursues eternal life and immortality by consuming human blood. Their first target is South Korea, where they have infiltrated society at all echelons.

To combat this growing threat, the South Korean government established "Andamir," a special task force operating under the direct command of the President, dedicated to eradicating Magyo.

Meanwhile, Magyo devises a far more dangerous plan to awaken "First Blood," the ancient progenitor of their cult, who lies dormant beneath the glaciers of the Himalayas. In order to succeed in this plan, they need the blood of Jeon Jun-seok, a direct descendant of the legendary Joseon-era Taoist master Jeon Woo-chi, who once fought against First Blood and sacrificed everything to seal First Blood away.

Desperate to capture Jeon Jun-seok, Magyo hunts him down. But Jun-seok is nothing more than a timid and ordinary high school student-until his fateful clash with Magyo awakens his true identity.
Now, alongside Andamir, Jun-seok must stand against Magyo's sinister ambitions and fight to protect humanity.

description:
The end of his seven-year unrequited love came with a cruel sentence.

*“I’ve fallen in love with someone. I need your help.”*

From the very first time they met, those words slipped out from between the man’s thin, red lips, piercing his heart.

*“But the thing is, that person isn’t interested in me at all. I was hoping you could help me. I think you’d know what to do.”*

He had no idea how he could possibly help, but he still nodded. If he opened his mouth, he felt like he would break down crying, so all he could do was keep nodding over and over. The ending of a long unrequited love… as a stand-in for someone else’s lover. Was this really going to be okay?

title: Choice of Choices
description:
For four years, Ji-In has been working as an actor in Korea. While on a photo shoot in Bangkok, a man approaches him, and for the first time, Ji-In gives in to his advances. Although the man’s expressions linger in his mind, he returns to Seoul pretending to be unaffected, as he always has. However, an unexpected reunion with the man shakes his calm exterior.

 *“I can be pushy sometimes. I’m just pretending to be patient because I don’t want you to dislike me.”*

As the man’s persistence reveals more than his initial suave demeanor, Ji-In finds himself slowly drawn to him. This is a story about men making imperfect choices, seeking change for themselves and their loved ones, and discovering the best decisions amidst life's many options.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: Illyuchoegang Namsachin
description:
In the modern era, dungeons and monsters appear, and awakened humans emerge. The awakened, possessing extraordinary power and abilities, became hunters to protect the world, and a power structure formed around them. But this was all irrelevant to Mu-Jin... or was it? Due to his female friend Ji-Su, who had returned, Mu-Jin's life, which had sought normality, changed spectacularly! 

Sixteen-year-old Mu-Jin receives a thunderbolt confession from Ji-Su, his childhood friend he's known since they were little. She claims to have returned from a distant future where an evil organization conquered the world, making it a dreadful place to live. She says the Mu-Jin she saw before dying crushed enemies with overwhelming power. Therefore, “You... become my comrade!” Though this absurd confession makes Mu-Jin slightly concerned about Ji-Su's mental state, his arrogant conceit, thinking a hunter's life might be fun, leads him to enroll in the Hunter Academy. A born genius with a body of steel and sharp wit, the ultimate overpowered munchkin Mu-Jin enters the academy with outstanding grades despite minimal training and becomes a disciple of the King of Power.

The only thing different from the past is Mu-Jin. Even so, can Ji-Su change a future destined only for destruction?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: A Plausible Lie
description:
“Perhaps just a casual sleepover, you know… that sort of thing?”

Hyun-oh fell silent for a moment at Lee Yeon’s question.
His expression remained unruffled, calm yet simultaneously darkened with a flicker of anger.

“If that’s all within your limits… Well, fine. I suppose that’ll do.”

Lee Yeon’s eyes narrowed. Even though she’d brought it up first, hearing it from his mouth felt like a final blow, stabbing her heart deeply.
Hyun-oh reached out his hand. Lee Yeon flinched, but as always, she didn’t pull away.

“You’ve changed a lot, Jeong Yi-yeon.”

The hand that had been caressing her cheek brushed her ear and slowly trailed downward. The fingertips that had been tracing her skin slowly dug into the space between her nape and the collar of her shirt.

“Think about sleeping with me too.”

title: Condemnation
description:
At first, I thought it was just a fleeting connection.
But then, we met again in a completely unexpected way.

"How should I interpret this painting?"
"I need you."

I was a dancer who had lost her sight,
and you were someone who had to use even me.

"There's no love in this marriage."

So, he arrogantly said, there would be no reason for him to love me.

A marriage where I shouldn't dare hope for love.
But a marriage where I had to deceive everyone by pretending to love.

I slowly nodded.

"Remember. Why am I with this man?"

The grim truth I learned three years ago, the betrayal that burned my whole being.
The tragedy of that day that sent me plummeting into an endless abyss.

I've replayed it dozens of times, whipping myself.

"God. Never... let me regret the path I've chosen."

So, marrying that man,
acting in love, wasn't difficult.

*

But.

"Please... kill me.
" What should I do? "I have no intention of letting you go until I die,"

the man declared, clutching my slender neck.

"If you're guilty, it's that I love you so desperately." It was

n't until after the play that I finally realized,

"Ah... God has abandoned me."

It was a perfect condemnation.

title: End of the Show Window
description:
“I don’t need someone who dedicates themselves to me. I just need someone who does their job well.”

A man who attracts the attention of the public as much as the president. A man called the next president.

Lee Suho. He is my husband.

“Mayor Lee Suho! Is it true that you and your wife are a show-window couple?!”

Just before the launch of a new administrative district, my relationship with my husband was exposed. I had been with him the longest, but I could never become his real family.

“Mayor, you need a child right now. Just like you needed a wife before.”

I fell for his fiery ambition and wanted to support his cause in any way I could.

“Get a grip, a pregnancy? You and I must stick to what’s necessary.”

“Just add the additional clauses to the contract. I will not hold you back with a child.”

“Min Sojung. I don’t need someone who dedicates themselves to me. I just need someone who does their job well.”

But what came from my husband was a cold rejection.

If it were like the original, this country would be destroyed?

The reason for the destruction?
The female protagonist asked for a map, but the tyrant emperor took what his finger was pointing to as the 'country' on the map, not the 'map'!

"That was the map I wanted!"

"You just wanted the paper with the map drawn on it? 

"Why?"

"Because the gold frame is pretty..."

I want to kill those guys. To prevent the destruction of my country and save my life, I went to the empire to sign a peace treaty.

However, life did not always go as planned.

The condition of the peace treaty that the empire's nobles insisted on was a marriage alliance.

"Grant the princess to the victorious general who won without shedding a drop of blood, Your Majesty."

description:
"Show it to the camera.”

“From next time on, Cha Seoyun, don’t put anything on either.
Because I want to see something even hotter.”
“Then the chair might end up soaked while we’re in a meeting.”

Team Leader Jeong Jaejin of JS Asset Management’s Hong Kong branch fund management team—
and the time I spend having thrilling video meetings with him twice a week.
How did things ever end up like this…?

Inside a video-call window I hadn’t managed to close,
I came face-to-face with my boss, Jaejin, completely naked.

“Look at those proportions. Is he, like, around 190 cm?”
“Wow… his ass.”
“…And.”

“My god. They say the bigger the better, but that is *way* too big—even if it’s big!”
“Are you sexually harassing me right now?”

I’d been caught.
Just as I was trembling with anxiety at the dizzying truth—that I’d teased someone so far above my pay grade—

“If you’re sorry, then let me see, too.”
“W-What… see what?”
“What do you think. You. Naked.”

“Please turn off the screen-recording function.”

A fantasy-fulfillment romance with an unusually shared kink—two people of a feather finding each other.

title: Nado Saramiya
description:
Byeong-Pil, who was just discharged from the military, is conflicted about whether to return to the department he had chosen out of necessity or to find another future. At that moment, he receives a request from his senior and friend, Man-Su, to find his uncle, and with financial support from Man-Su's family, he works part-time to 'ind Man-Su's uncle with Man-Su. Since the disappearance was not related to a crime, the police drew the line that it was not their job, and since his whereabouts were completely unknown as a missing person, even the detective agency gave up, but Byeong-Pil searches for traces of his uncle through his own investigation. By entering the world of his uncle, which he had no interest in and no need to know about, and encountering his uncle's agony, joy, and ideals, Byeong-Pil's eyes are opened in a new way. Byeong-Pil meaningfully organizes his career path that he had been contemplating.

title: In the Garden of Ashes
description:
In a distant future where almost no life remains on Earth, a single garden glows faintly green amid drifting gray ash. Within it live a few surviving creatures and a modified human named Adam.

One day, a demon and his contractor visit the garden. Noticing Adam’s loneliness, they cut off one of his fingers, shaping it into a new living being before leaving again.

Alone together in the garden, Adam raises this new life and passes down his knowledge. Yet even as he feels comfort in its presence, he cannot ignore the strange aversion he feels toward a being born from his own flesh.

As the new life grows increasingly obsessed with him, Adam tries to keep his distance. At last, their tension reaches a breaking point.

*“What does it matter?”*  
*“Is that why I was never given a name?”*

“Would you like to use me tonight?” Cha Mona had everything. Beauty, talent, background. Everything except one thing: luck with men. “Why does every guy I date end up like this?” It was the day she broke up with her boyfriend. The same boyfriend she found rolling around in her bed with another woman. “I’m turning thirty next year, and every single relationship I’ve had has been a failure. Is there really not a single decent guy out there?” “Director, do you really need to date?” Kang Doha wasn’t just Mona’s secretary. He was someone she had known for over ten years, like a younger brother. Or so she thought. Until he said something no one could have expected. “Would you like to use me tonight?” In the noisy restaurant, his low voice was the only thing that rang clear in her ears. Why was her heart racing like this? Just like it did that day, eight years ago, when they saw each other again for the first time.
