description:
What would you do if you were terminally ill and had only half a year to live? Would you fight to the end to create a miracle, or use the little time left to live the life you want? At Musashino Shichijuji Hospital, a patient battling leukemia received advice: whenever he felt hopeless, he should seek out dermatologist Kiriko for advice, he would advise him on everything, every disease. He was the doctor known as the Grim Reaper - the doctor who drove people to death. 

In contrast to Grim Reaper Kiriko is the vice director Fukuhara, the magic hand of Shichijuji Hospital's surgical department. While Kiriko believes that terminally ill people should be free to choose how they face death, Fukuhara is determined not to give up fighting for his patients, no matter how hopeless the disease is. 

Faced with life and death, what choice will the patient make?  What will be the outcome of the battle between two talented doctors with completely different perspectives? Welcome to the first episode of “The Last Doctor Under the Cherry Blossoms” – a touching story about the medical profession!

title: Seoljunghongok
description:
Yeon, who had nothing, now has two things he had never had before. One is Mu-Jin, who gives Yeon a warmth he never felt before and then takes it away. The other is Seoljunghongok, a rare jewel ambitiously prepared by the Demonic Cult. When he learns of the Hongok’s ability to easily absorb the opponent’s internal energy with just his pretty face, the former becomes Yeon’s goal, and the latter becomes Yeon’s means. Yeon swallows Seoljunghongok without hesitation. And he realizes it. If he really had this bead, even he, who came from a poor family, could build martial arts skills that no one would envy. Yeon immediately goes to face the famous masters of the Jeongpa. He must dream of a better future? He now chews on the words Mu-Jin told him in order to get revenge on him. However, what Yeon realizes through that adventure is none other than the preciousness of his comrades by his side. His deep affection for Mu-Jin cannot be erased no matter how much he tries to deny it. However, he cannot easily stop now, no matter how much he tries to. Because in the past, Yeon has crossed too many lines and made too many people his enemy.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: Yeorangdang
description:
"Our destiny is a promise that has waited a thousand years." 

Yeorangdang tells the story of love and sacrifice that has been revived in Andong over a millennium. It follows a woman who devoted everything to protect the king of Goryeo and the warrior who endured countless reincarnations for her sake. Their bond transcends time and is rekindled in modern-day Andong.

Amidst the invasion of the Red Turbans, the woman sacrifices herself to protect King Gongmin, leading to a reunion of two souls who have longed for each other. Their story blooms along the banks of the Nakdong River, shining with miraculous moments born from years of waiting.

Yeorangdang depicts those who carry memories of their past lives under the night sky of Andong, recognizing each other and finally realizing their love. 

It is a profound tale that conveys the essence of fate and love.

title: Queen's Harem
description:
After a long war, peace has come. Leticia Belletium, the sole heir to the victorious kingdom of Lakia, makes a bold declaration at her coronation: “For the sake of peace in the kingdom, I swear never to marry for the rest of my life. 

However, I plan to establish a royal harem and produce a legitimate heir to carry on the royal bloodline.” After careful selection, three men were chosen: Kael Romus, from Lakia’s most powerful noble family and a childhood friend of Queen Leticia. Harkan, the knight who has served her faithfully on the battlefield. Elody Riers, a royal descendant of the defeated nation of Zamel, offered to her as a token of surrender. 

These men became Leticia’s royal consorts. Leticia couldn’t understand what was happening. “Your Majesty, it’s alright. The wetter it is here, the easier the insertion will be.” “R-Really?” “So allow me to make it even wetter. 

"You must plant your seed.” Even the one who was meant to become the kingdom’s chancellor... “No, my liege. Call me disloyal, tear out my hair—I don’t care. But trying to drive me away from your side… that I will never forgive.” Even the war hero whose title and future were guaranteed... “Your Majesty, you need to conceive, don’t you?” Even the prisoner from Zamel, who was meant to be trained and sent back... None of them seem to want to leave Leticia’s harem... for some reason.

title: Nareul Jugil Aireul Kiunda

unknown.title: Raising a Child Who Will Kill Me

description:
Medusa, a monster known for her grotesque appearance but who in truth loves children, comes across a child destined to kill her inside a chest that has washed ashore. Determined to avoid her fate of death, she resolves not to kill the child but to raise him instead. She gives him a name and lovingly brings him up. Carefully dodging the potentially fatal crises caused by the child’s every little action, Medusa does her best at childcare. However, a group of humans searching for the child eventually appears before her. Medusa soon realises that they have come to kill him… 

Will Medusa be able to escape her destined death and live happily with the child? 

A reinterpretation of Medusa—the widely known monster of myth—as a warm, heroic protagonist, along with a newly imagined relationship with her nemesis Perseus. A work intended to be easy to read even for those unfamiliar with the original myth. 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: The CEO's Child
description:
“Do I seem like the type to live off women?”

It was just one night,

yet Yeon Dahae turned my life upside down.

Running into her again was pure chance.

“I’m sorry for leaving without paying you.”

“Yeon Dahae, manager of the upcoming ‘Only You: Coffee & Flower,’ opening next week.”

I couldn’t let this slip by.

“I’m not after money—I’d rather settle it differently. What do you say?”

I had to figure out why that morning, when she left without a word, I felt so hollow and restless.

“How about this: we meet whenever we want, without strings or complications?”

She said that even Donghwa, the only man in her life, was gone.

All I needed to do was enjoy it—nothing more.

“Fine, but no meddling in each other’s personal lives or work.”

I was certain I wouldn’t get too attached…

So why do I keep wanting to stay near her?

Why won’t this odd feeling fade?

The moment Ji-an saw him again, she realized... She thought she had run far away, but in the end, she had gone nowhere. If she could never escape, she decided to at least keep him in her sight. 

At Ji-an’s fearless words, "A marriage like this is fine," Do-jin stepped closer and warned her in a low voice: "Can you really do this with me?"

As he closed the distance, so much that she could feel his breath, Ji-an did not look away and firmly replied: "I can. I'm an actress."

After that passionate first kiss, Do-jin became a different person, charging toward her like a bulldozer. But the wounds and misunderstandings built up over time stood between them.

title: HODO: A Life In Two Acts

unknown.title: HODO: A Life In Two Acts

description:
At first there was “Lake,” and then there was “Island.” Or was it the other way around? A story told in two parts, it is up to the reader to determine where they’d like to begin this eerie journey. Based on a true story that Yeong-shin Ma felt compelled to help share, together these two parts are Hodo—the story of a painter, whose hard and dark past is brought to life with sensitivity and authenticity. Lake— Hodo is haunted—by her mother and step-mother, her classmates, a neighbor, and yes, literal ghosts. She is also five years old. Through masterful cartooning, we see a child’s despair in the face of pervasive violence, and her confusion as to why bad things keep happening to her. We see the edges of her depression begin to appear. Island— Hodo is haunted—by her past, a friend’s suicide, her sister’s heartbreaking yet unsurprising betrayal, and yes, literal ghosts, still. Through masterful cartooning, we see a woman reckoning with her past and the shadow it has cast on her adulthood. But we also see her develop her artistic practice and witness her determination to find herself through her paintbrush. Because despite the incredible pain, Hodo is a story of light in the dark—a story of hope.
Source: Drawn & Quarterly

titles.title: HODO: A Life In Two Acts

description: Our story begins with young Théna, apprentice swordsman and resident of Little Island, an island far too small for her audacity and thirst to discover the world. An irresistible desire to go to the continent does not leave her, and a mysterious wandering boy whom she saves in extremis from danger could well be her first adventure companion! But they will have to be wary of the cruel King Mimas, a real threat to any hope of freedom...

title: River of Souls
description:
Lumi has always dismissed the strange "ghosts" she sees until her best friend Rachel disappears, only to return as a ghost. Now Lumi must face the world she never believed in and solve the mystery of Rachel's disappearance. Diving deeper into the darkness, Lumi discovers that some truths are more terrifying and painful than any ghost.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Infiniseed
description:
Allan Rose, an orphan awakener with the potential to be one of the strongest S-rankers has been stuck at level one for eight years. He often dreams of reaching his full potential but is always awakened to the cruel reality of being a poor F-ranker who must steal to put food on the table. One day his best friend convinces him to go on an illegal expedition so that he can finally see what it's like to be a true awakener. Unfortunately, things go south, and Allan finds himself standing at death's door. Against all odds he survives, and finds out that whatever was keeping him from leveling up has disappeared. Now, with the ability to level up, he is doing whatever he can to gain strength so that can he bring happiness and luxury to his orphanage family.

(Source: Webtoons)

title: Star Catcher
description:
After battling with numerous hardships and an unsuccessful attempt at his own life, Lucas transformed from a true ray of sunshine to a meek and depressed young adult. He shuts out those around him to focus on his studies at the world-renowned Star Valley University in the hopes of making a positive impact in the world one day. Never would he imagine that a by-chance run in with a stranger would result in him learning to forgive and love himself, and find the passion to live life for himself again.

(Source: Webtoon)

description:
Drowned in overwhelming guilt and despair, Father Vence Reich decides to end it all in the quiet solitude of his village monastery. But just as his fingers brace on the trigger of his rifle, a blinding white light bursts through the gloom. Suspended from the attic ceiling is a terrifying yet mesmerizing entity—and Vence instantly falls to his knees, convinced he is looking at God. As he surrenders both his body and soul to this "God" of snake-like tongues and luminous tentacles, Vence spirals into a deep, consuming dependency. In the name of devotion, the unholy communion begins...

title: Run to Heaven
description: 2036, as armed conflict rages between the northern and southern islands of Arrecquero, Fee tries to live her teenage life. Every day, she runs along the coast in the hope of catching a glimpse of her mother's ship, an admiral who has gone off to fight. Marginal and passionate, the young girl decides to go barefoot and take part in the sports festival organized during the World Games break. But joy soon gives way to the horror of war, and the teenager has to run for her freedom.

title: La leyenda de Hakutaku
description:
Yuki, a young deaf girl, is destined to lead her village, inheriting a long lineage. But in this superstitious community plagued by disasters, many see her deafness as a curse linked to the Hakutaku, a legendary creature accused of bringing misfortune. This includes her former friend Dai, who believes himself more capable of being leader and makes her life difficult.

One day, Yuki meets the real Hakutaku in the woods. Far from being a monster, it protects the village from hostile forces and can even communicate with her through telepathy. As a storm approaches, Yuki and the Hakutaku join forces to save the village and to challenge the unfounded beliefs of its people.
